messages:
alex: Heads-up: CI microbench failed on PR 15432 — p95 latency +12% on kv-scheduler path. Dashboard: https://perf.redwood.local/runs/15432
ci-bot: Job failed: //ci/microbench:kv_scheduler_test (flake guard). Artifacts -> https://ci.redwood.local/15432/artifacts
jin: I pulled the artifacts. Repro on the shadow job: p50 ~ same, p95 jumped. Diff shows more scalar kernel hits. raw logs: `KernelSelected: quant_opt -> scalar_kernel` repeated.
sara: Kernel falling back to scalar_kernel would explain the tail. Also noticed config change in PR: scheduler_weights.json was updated. commit: https://git.redwood/infra/commit/3c9a7b
otto: (typo) otto: KV cache hitrate in the failing run is 12% vs baseline 48%. Telemetry snippet: `kv.hits=1200, kv.misses=8800` for a 10k sample. That suggests cache thrash around the same time scalar kernels spike.
alex: Did the PR touch batching heuristics or seqlen sampler? Those can change routing and make early eviction thrash the KV cache.
jin: It touched scheduler weight normalization and a tiny change in batch timer threshold (0.5ms -> 0.4ms). Patch excerpt:
```
- batch_timer_ms = 0.5
+ batch_timer_ms = 0.4
scheduler_weights = {"quant_opt": 0.9, "quant_fallback": 0.1}
```
This could increase fanout and cause shorter prefix reuse.
sara: Reproduced locally by forcing the shorter batch timer. Ran nperf with the same seq length distribution: `./nperf --profile --seq-dist=prod_seed_42 --iterations=2000`
jin: Local profile + flamegraph: heavy stacks in `scalar_kernel_dispatch` and `kv_eviction` during the same time window. Flame snippet: `scalar_kernel_dispatch -> kv_lookup -> kv_eviction` dominates.
otto: Bisect plan: check the two commits in the merge window that touched scheduler or batching ms. Candidate commits: 3c9a7b (scheduler_weights), 4b2f1d (seqlen-sampler tweak). I can run a narrow bisect across those two.
alex: Hold the rollout for the release train — label this rollout-blocker. If the bisect points to scheduler_weights, prefer reverting that patch instead of full rollback.
perf-bot: Started bisect job: //ci/bisect:kv_scheduler_bisect with candidates [3c9a7b,4b2f1d]. Will post status to this thread.
jin: I can open a hotfix PR to revert the batch_timer change and restore previous scheduler_weights. Will attach microbench diff in the PR: p95 delta ~ -11% when reverted. Expected quick fix timeline: ~1-2 hours to get CI green.
alex: Thanks. Tagging @release on this thread and adding to today's standup notes.
